items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Then he went with a guy named Erskine Tate at a theater called the Vendome in Chicago.

ctx.x: Were they friends before Joe bought his contract?

Well, Joe had worked for him -- I mean, Louie had worked for Louie -- I mean, for Joe because Joe had the Sunset Cafe in Chicago and he worked for Joe for a while. Then he went with a guy named Erskine Tate at a theater called the Vendome in Chicago. And that's when this guy -- I can't think of his name offhand -- and he picked Louie up and took him to Europe. And I don't know what happened between he and Louie but they couldn't get along evidently and that's when they had the fight and all that. So he wanted to…

And then Joe and Louie have been, ever since, buddy-buddy-buddy. Louie never did want for any money, you know, but he -- Joe gave him a salary. Because, you know, if you gave him all his money, he would give it away because he's so big-hearted. So he put him on a salary.
